stapler-mcp._supersedes: read-website-fast, website-downloader, docs-mcp-server, brave-search -- one shared native daemon (thin stdio client per session) instead of a fresh npx/uvx process tree per subagent. Requires `cargo install --path crates/cli` from the stapler-mcp repo. Uses an absolute path rather than relying on PATH resolution: the process that spawns MCP servers doesn't always inherit a shell profile that's run `pathadd "$HOME/.cargo/bin"` (see .shell/exports.sh), so the bare command name silently failed to resolve and the server never started. brave-search removed 2026-08-12: stapler-mcp's brave_web_search covers real usage; the official server's only extra capability (brave_local_search) saw ~zero use. Requires BRAVE_API_KEY in the environment of whichever thin client first spawns the daemon.

1password._requires: 1Password desktop app installed natively (not Flatpak/Snap) with Settings > Developer > 'Integrate with MCP clients' turned on. after-install.sh symlinks the binary to /usr/local/bin. Fails to start (command not found) on machines without the app — same graceful-failure pattern as stapler-mcp needing BRAVE_API_KEY.
